description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /customer/account/editPost.
affected_versions: Adobe Adobe Commerce: 0 through 2.4.9-2026-jul, 2.4.8-2026-aug, 2.4.7-2026-aug, 2.4.6-2026-aug, 2.4.5-2026-aug, 2.4.4-2026-aug; Adobe Adobe Commerce B2B: 0 through 1.5.3-2026-jul, 1.5.2-2026-jul, 1.4.2-2026-jul, 1.3.4-2026-jul, 1.3.3-2026-jul; Adobe Magento Open Source: 0 through 2.4.9-2026-jul, 2.4.8-2026-jul, 2.4.7-2026-jul, 2.4.6-2026-jul; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks POST requests to the documented vulnerable operation at /customer/account/editPost.
limitations: The body or authentication mechanism is not inspected; disabling this delivery endpoint is not exploit detection. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Blocks legitimate uses of this operation too. This is a temporary containment option for policies that can disable the operation; review application compatibility before enabling.
